_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/test_spell_or_permanent.py and tests/unit/test_enters_unless_cost.py. t_sink is Sink into Stupor's front face -- one target spanning the stack and the battlefield. t_springs is the back face's clause, and t_plain_shockless is the same land with the offer removed, kept live because it is the card that would ship if the clause were dropped.
